title: Causal Fair Machine Learning via Rank-Preserving Interventional Distributions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and philosophical foundations of causal fairness in automated decision-making systems. While it draws on philosophical concepts like Aristotle's 'task-specific merit' to define fairness normatively, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical frameworks as subjects of study, nor does it apply these to language models.
